question:
**Select the correct option:**

The physician spoke ___, avoiding technical jargon so patients could understand.
solution:
The correct answer is '**perspicuously**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**perspicuously**" means "clearly and understandably," which fits the context of a physician speaking in a way that avoids technical jargon.
 
• **Perspicaciously** (Option 2) refers to being insightful or having a keen understanding, which does not match the context of the sentence.
